ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across >90% of the visible surface with sparse, high-intensity (white) localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field spanning both lobes; high-intensity mottling and focal clusters concentrated on the distal tip of the left lobe; discrete high-intensity points scattered across central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 70-degree V-shaped depression with deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks reaching 5-10 pixels; most pronounced at the distal edges, transitioning to smoother topography toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to a sharp distal termination.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast circular pixel groups at the left lobe tip; secondary isolated circular mark in the mid-right lobe region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions; one prominent diagonal stroke on the lower-left lobe and another on the mid-upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Calcified, high-contrast structural protrusions consistent with barnacle colonization on the terminal tip of the left fluke lobe.
